description: Independent researchers and open-weight communities intensify efforts to reconstruct frontier AI capabilities using distillation, leaked telemetry, and model fragments. Dubbed 'Project Chimera,' the initiative demonstrates functional substitutes for high-end models on EU-controlled infrastructure, raising the prospect of sovereign, open-source resilience against strategic denial. While still behind the closed frontier, the pace of progress suggests a viable path to closing the gap, sparking debate about long-term alternatives to dependency.
